description: Create a saved view. board needs group_by (a select, a single user, or a one-to-many relation field); calendar needs date_field; timeline needs start_date_field/end_date_field; board/gallery/list show card_fields (chips on calendar); form takes form_* to build the actual public-facing form (title/fields/access) — a bare "form" type with no form_* params creates an unconfigured, members-only form.

filters.description: Filter AST by field api_name — same shape as query_records (See also: get_started section "FILTERS").

folder.description: #347 — put the view in this sidebar FOLDER (name or id) instead of nesting it under its database. Placement only: the view still belongs to its database. Omit to nest it under the database, which is the default.

form_access.description: form: who can open/submit it — members (signed-in only, default), link (anyone with the generated link), or public. link/public auto-generate a shareable token, returned in the result as config.form.public_token (the public URL is <web app>/f/<public_token>).

form_description.description: form: helper text shown under the title.

form_fields.description: form: which fields to show, in order — a field ref, or {field, required, label, help, visible_when, required_when, hidden, value} for per-field overrides. `hidden`+`value` stamps a fixed value onto every submission without ever showing that field to the visitor — a job/tenant id, a UTM tag. Omit to fall back to card_fields.

hidden.description: #716 — never shown to the visitor; pair with `value` to stamp a fixed value onto every submission (a tenant/job/source id, a UTM tag). Cannot be combined with visible_when (the API rejects that as a config error) — hidden means never rendered to anyone, visible_when means conditionally rendered.

required_when.description: #715 — `required` above only bites when this also holds (or is unset).

field.description: An EARLIER field in this same form (by name or id) whose answer controls this one.

value.description: Ignored by is_empty/not_empty. `in` takes an array.

#716 — the fixed value a hidden field stamps onto every record this form creates, applied server-side from stored config — a visitor can never override it by posting their own value for that field. Shape depends on the field's type (a relation target id/number, a select/workflow option, plain text); validated when the view is saved.

visible_when.description: #715 — show this field only when an earlier answer matches.

field.description: An EARLIER field in this same form (by name or id) whose answer controls this one.

value.description: Ignored by is_empty/not_empty. `in` takes an array.

form_redirect_url.description: form: redirect here (an http:// or https:// address only) instead of showing success_message.

form_success_message.description: form: message shown after a successful submit.

form_title.description: form: heading shown to the visitor (defaults to the database name).

group_by.description: board: field to group columns by — a select, a single user, or the single side of a one-to-many relation (one column per related record).

hidden_columns.description: board (select/workflow group-by only): option LABELS (or ids) of columns NOT to draw, empty or not — e.g. ["Triage","Backlog","Done"]. Different from hiding empty columns. Pass [] to show every column again. Changing group_by without passing this clears it.
